reason: I'd take the free six-week test because it costs me nothing, but I'm not paying $2,000 a month for a tool I've never seen run against our own POs. Every new spend needs a payback story I can show the owner, and right now I don't have one.
objection: Another tool my buyers have to log into. My team already juggles Epicor, the supplier portal and email, and a startup reading our POs and supplier emails raises a data-handling question before it raises a savings question.
would_change_my_mind: A free test that shows, on our own open POs, a couple of real late or short shipments caught before they hit a work order, with the drafted supplier follow-ups our buyers would actually send.
